newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-TEN-MAN HIBS BEAT AIRDRIE 1-0 IN PLAY-OFF.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEN-MAN HIBS BEAT AIRDRIE 1-0 IN PLAY-OFF.

text.p: An own-goal from Airdrie's Steve Cooper gave 10-man Hibernian a 1-0 win in the first leg of a Scottish league play-off tie on Saturday.
Premier division Hibs clung to their 13th-minute lead despite having defender Gordon Hunter sent off for a second bookable offence just before halftime.
He will miss the second leg at Airdrie on Thursday which will decide which of the two sides plays in the top flight next season.
Hibernian finished second-from-bottom of the premier division this season. Airdrie finished second in the first division.
